adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the updated `updateEvent` computes:
```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```
The `find(...)` branch only runs when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, but then it tries to match `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `undefined`/`null`), which will not select a real destination calendar externalId. This regresses the prior behavior (`: event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) that would fall back to the event’s destination calendar when `externalCalendarId` wasn’t provided, so updates can target the wrong calendar or end up with an undefined selection.
